o.text: Borrowed from Arabic فَائِض (fāʔiḍ), active participle of فَاضَ (fāḍa).
From Proto-Turkic *ïjs (“smell, odour”). Cognate with Chuvash йӑс (jăs) and Turkish is.
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *esne-. Cognate with Turkish esnemek, Uzbek esnamoq, Tatar иснәү (isnäw), Chuvash анасла (anasla), etc.
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish انكنار (enginar, inginar, “artichoke”), from Greek αγκινάρα (agkinára).
From Arabic تَأْيِينَات (taʔyīnāt). The sense "purpose, function" is likely a semantic loan from Russian назначе́ние (naznačénije).
